## Change and scope

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link the issue or S1 task, if assigned.

- Exact commands run and their results:
- Checks not run and why:

## Review

- [ ] The diff is limited to the stated scope and preserves existing evidence and attribution.
- [ ] Public content contains no credentials, private data, model artifacts, hidden evaluation material, or local task identifiers.
- [ ] Changes follow [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/kris0516/ToolAlign/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md); shared contracts, dependencies, and coordination state remain under S1 coordination.

Coordinated work requires R1 review and S1 integration. Keep proposals pending coordination as drafts; this checklist is not an approval record.
